acquisition.boundary: Half-open UTC months expressed with an inclusive endtime equal to next-month midnight minus one millisecond
acquisition.provenance: Keep raw receipt and bytes private, record URL, response SHA, UTC, provider/source network and provenance exclusions. Admit only confirmed reviewed US preferred numeric data and locally render the chart.
acquisition.stop: Any empty, truncation at 1000, transport failure, unbound identity, or incomplete monthly result halts the confirmation scope; retain the observed denominators.

candidate: Original USGS72 Hygon Gemma LoRA after 25 actual updates

limitations: historic reverse alias coverage can be incomplete
identity_gate.procedure: Project only aliases, ID, UTC, coordinates and prior split, chart, group and media identities. Verify all six pins before any new GET. Record how the two additional historical views map into the included source inventory; if a complete map cannot be proved, stop before acquisition.

inference.answer_isolation: Freeze input denominators before answers. Keep answers away from target. Score only after all 288 prediction slots and original terminal accounting are sealed.

legacy_anchors.scope: all 24 render144 selected windows, including both first blind groups
all prior rendered chart, split, group and image identities
all 216 R26 donors, including the 72 selected events

confidence_interval.method: Paired resampling of eight whole groups with replacement, percentile 95%, linear interpolation

scoring.primary: Equal-weight mean of eight paired group differences of exact content accuracy, including wrong, uninterpretable and capped answers as zero. Separate incomplete infrastructure results and withhold confirmation if any planned slot lacks terminal disposition.
secondary: all 16 per-type denominators including depth change and both depth extrema
strict FINAL and both-decodable subset descriptive only

selection.algorithm: Hash-sort eligible groups with SHA256 of UTF-8 seed concatenated with SHA256 of the sorted canonical primary IDs. Within each group sort by UTC then primary ID. Partition into six-row nonoverlapping windows and take the first two valid full windows. Require nonconstant displayed magnitude and depth columns as in the original input gate. Choose the first eight groups with two valid windows after provenance and identity exclusion. No selection by answer, outcome, or sign of differences.
checks_before_labels: all 8 groups, 16 charts, and 96 distinct source events
no known event or alias overlap
no prior group, chart or PNG digest overlap
same renderer family and unchanged six task kinds
selection.new_internal_closure: Join the remaining new events by the previously used 30-degree latitude and 60-degree longitude cells, including transitive strong links.
selection.strong_closure: Across old and new, alias intersection OR both distance <= 500 km and time difference <= 72 hours; take transitive closure. Exclude all components touching historical inputs.
